assessment.summary: CST3 (cystatin C) is a secreted cysteine protease inhibitor with ageing-related disease associations (AMD, chronic kidney disease) and a high ageing literature share. MR of the measured protein with 6 cis instruments shows no significant effect on parental longevity, frailty or GrimAge acceleration, and no colocalisation or replication data were returned. Project context concerns the DNAm surrogate (higher in schizophrenia/FEP) and does not speak to the measured protein's causal role. It has some tractability, no liabilities listed and no clinical drugs. Recommendation: deprioritise.
